patterns.meaning: -ing: tính chất của sự vật/người gây ra cảm xúc (a boring film, an interesting book). -ed: cảm xúc của người (I am bored, she was interested). Cặp hay gặp: bored/boring, interested/interesting, excited/exciting, disappointed/disappointing, fascinated/fascinating, exhausted/exhausting, embarrassed/embarrassing.
examples: The film was boring, so I felt bored. — Bộ phim chán nên tôi thấy chán.
I was fascinated by the exhibition. It was fascinating. — Tôi bị cuốn hút bởi triển lãm. Nó thật cuốn hút.
The ending was disappointing, and many viewers were disappointed. — Cái kết gây thất vọng, nhiều khán giả thất vọng.

patterns.meaning: Opinion (beautiful) – Size (big) – Age (old) – Shape (round) – Colour (red) – Origin (Vietnamese) – Material (silk) – Purpose (dining) + Noun. Thường chỉ dùng 2–3 tính từ.
examples: a beautiful old Vietnamese painting — một bức tranh Việt Nam cổ đẹp
a small round wooden table — một chiếc bàn gỗ tròn nhỏ
a lovely red silk áo dài — một chiếc áo dài lụa đỏ xinh xắn

patterns.form: too … (for sb) to V / … enough (for sb) to V
patterns.meaning: too + adj/adv + (for sb) + to V: quá… đến nỗi không. adj/adv + enough + (for sb) + to V: đủ… để. enough + N + to V: đủ (danh từ) để. Không có 'very' trước 'too'.
examples: The tickets were too expensive for students to buy. — Vé quá đắt nên sinh viên không mua nổi.
The museum is close enough for us to walk there. — Bảo tàng đủ gần để chúng tôi đi bộ tới.
I don't have enough time to take up a new hobby. — Tôi không đủ thời gian để bắt đầu sở thích mới.

exercises.q: [Đọc hiểu – điền chỗ trống] Chọn từ phù hợp nhất
exercises.en: Water puppetry is one of Vietnam's oldest art forms, dating back nearly a thousand years. Farmers used to perform it in flooded rice fields after the harvest. Today, the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre in Hanoi welcomes thousands of visitors every week, most of whom are fascinated by the colourful wooden puppets. However, the number of young performers is falling because the training is long and the salary is too low ( ___ ) them to make a living. Some artists are now using social media to attract a younger audience.
exercises.explain: too low for them to make a living.

exercises.q: [Đọc hiểu – chi tiết] Vì sao nhiều bảo tàng châu Âu miễn phí vé?
exercises.en: Should governments spend public money on the arts? Some people argue that the money would be better spent on hospitals and schools. Others believe that museums, theatres and concerts are essential for a society because they help people relieve stress, appreciate their culture and broaden their minds. In many European cities, national museums do not charge an admission fee, so that everyone can enjoy art regardless of their income. Supporters say that this policy has made art more accessible, especially to children and students.
options: Để mọi người đều được thưởng thức nghệ thuật dù thu nhập thế nào
Vì chính phủ cấm thu phí

writing.title: Thư cảm ơn sau buổi biểu diễn
writing.prompt:
Last weekend, a friend took you to a traditional music performance.
Write an email to your friend. In your email:
• thank him/her
• say what you enjoyed most
• suggest another activity you could do together.
You should write at least 120 words.
outline: Hi + tên, + I'm writing to say a big thank you for…
Đoạn 1: cảm ơn + ấn tượng chung (dùng -ing/-ed: fascinating, I was fascinated…)
Đoạn 2: điều thích nhất (What I enjoyed most was… because…), 1 cụm tính từ đúng trật tự
Đoạn 3: rủ hoạt động khác (Next time, why don't we… ?)
Kết: Thanks again for everything. Hope to see you soon! / Best wishes,
phrases: I'm writing to say a big thank you for … — Mình viết để cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì …
I was absolutely fascinated by … — Mình thực sự bị cuốn hút bởi …
What I enjoyed most was … because … — Điều mình thích nhất là … vì …
Next time, why don't we go to … together? — Lần sau mình cùng đi … nhé?
Thanks again for such a wonderful evening. — Cảm ơn bạn lần nữa vì buổi tối tuyệt vời.

speaking.title: Social interaction: art & hobbies
speaking.prompt: Let's talk about art. Then let's talk about your hobbies.
questions: Do you like visiting museums or art galleries?
Have you ever watched a traditional performance such as water puppetry?
Is art important for children? Why?
What do you usually do in your free time?
Is there a hobby you would like to take up in the future?
Do you think hobbies help people relieve stress?
ideas: To be honest, I'm not very interested in…, but…
I was really fascinated when I watched…
I think art helps children develop…
In my free time, I usually…
I'd love to take up… but I'm too busy to…

quote.en: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
quote.vi: Nghệ thuật rửa trôi bụi bặm đời thường khỏi tâm hồn.

pron.title: Đuôi -ed trong tính từ cảm xúc
pron.rule: Áp dụng quy tắc -ed: interested /ɪd/, bored /d/, fascinated /ɪd/, embarrassed /t/, relaxed /t/.

phrases: it's not my cup of tea
corner.mistake: Hay nói 'I am boring' khi muốn nói 'tôi thấy chán' — nghĩa thành 'tôi là người nhàm chán'. Đúng: I am BORED.
corner.tip: Speaking Part 1: dùng đúng -ed/-ing và thêm một câu too…to / enough…to là cách đơn giản để thể hiện ngữ pháp B2.
corner.diary: Kể 3–5 câu về một bộ phim hay buổi diễn gần đây, dùng 2 cặp -ed/-ing, 1 cụm tính từ có trật tự đúng và 1 câu too/enough.
